title: AWS S3 Secure Object Storage
description: Enterprise-grade AWS S3 bucket with default server-side encryption (AES-256), public access prevention, and optional versioning

bucket_name_prefix.title: Bucket Name Prefix
bucket_name_prefix.description: Prefix used for S3 bucket name (will be automatically suffixed for global uniqueness)

enable_versioning.title: Enable Object Versioning
enable_versioning.description: Keep multiple variants of an object in the same bucket for auditability and recovery

force_destroy.title: Force Destroy on Teardown
force_destroy.description: Enables clean teardown even if test objects remain in bucket
